notes: The candidate raises only the shared Owner::advance commit/feedback/request work budget from 64 to 128; group/request visits and per-grant 64 datagrams, quantum, windows and queue capacities are unchanged.

All comparisons use frozen instrumented release-musl binaries and the same fresh Ubuntu 24.04 container image. Actual socket receive buffers are 425984 bytes in these runs; historical November 7 larger-buffer runs are not matched controls.
No local compilation, kernel tests or Git packing overlap load. Separate-machine migration tests may run concurrently. Build/test work may occur between sweeps.
Goodput excludes receiver drain; missing fractions and drop counters include drain. CPU 100% means one core; counter units differ and cannot be summed into exact loss.
Service peaks are lifetime gauges. Timing samples measure wall duration including scheduling. Insufficient window counts are necessary constraints, not exclusive blocking causes.
Both-override sweeps preserve ProbeRTT and stalled-PTO restrictions; the normal controller quantum remains unchanged. This is diagnostic code, not proposed production congestion behavior.
